items.name: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.one_liner: Unified multi-platform scraping CLI for AI agents
items.pain_point: AI developers waste weeks building platform-specific scrapers with fragile auth, rate limits, and anti-bot detection. Indie devs and startups building AI products need real-time social data but can't afford $100+/month Twitter API fees.
app_ideas: TrendPulse: Real-time cross-platform trend detection dashboard for marketers tracking viral content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube in one view
BrandRadar: Competitor monitoring SaaS that alerts businesses when competitors get mentioned across social platforms with sentiment analysis
CreatorStack: Content research tool for YouTubers/creators that aggregates Reddit discussions, Twitter debates, and GitHub repos related to their niche
items.monetization: B2B API wrapper with generous free tier → per-call pricing at $0.001-0.01/call, plus vertical SaaS products on top (TrendPulse, BrandRadar) with $29-99/month subscriptions
items.why_now: AI agent ecosystem just hit inflection point (49k stars in 7 days), every new agent needs web data access, and official APIs remain prohibitively expensive for indie devs

items.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.one_liner: Query any codebase as a knowledge graph via AI coding assistants
items.pain_point: Developers waste hours tracing code relationships across files, docs, and schemas. RAG loses context; AI coding tools hallucinate. Solo devs and small teams building complex systems need instant codebase comprehension without manual documentation.
app_ideas: VS Code extension showing interactive dependency graphs with click-to-navigate and 'explain this module' sidebar
GitHub Action that auto-generates architecture diagrams and changelog summaries from diffs
Standalone CLI for codebase Q&A with visual graph output, packaged as $5/mo subscription
items.monetization: Freemium (free for 1 repo, $10/mo for unlimited) + B2B API wrapper for enterprise dev tools vendors
items.why_now: AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) are exploding in adoption but lack deep codebase understanding—graph-based AST parsing fills this gap at exactly the right moment.
